# OmDev

> AI Search & GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) specialist based in Bermondsey, London (SE16). OmDev helps businesses get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, alongside traditional SEO. Founder: Omar. Contact: omar@omdev.xyz.

OmDev offers an AI-Visibility Audit (the entry point) and a monthly GEO + SEO retainer. Focus sectors: wellness & clinics, professional services (law, accountancy, dental), and multi-location local brands. Proven result: grew Plum Pilates' visibility by 50%.

## Services
- [AI-Visibility Audit & GEO + SEO](https://omdev.xyz/#offer): How OmDev works — audit first, then ongoing retainer.
- [Wellness & Clinics](https://omdev.xyz/ai-visibility-wellness): GEO + SEO for pilates, physio, dental, aesthetics and clinics.
- [Professional Services](https://omdev.xyz/ai-visibility-professional-services): GEO + SEO for law, accountancy and dental firms.
- [Multi-Location Brands](https://omdev.xyz/ai-visibility-multi-location): GEO + local SEO for franchises and multi-site businesses.
